Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Coord: v2 inference release sequencing & documentation exceptions

Team —

High level: product is targeting a controlled staged rollout for v2 inference (model + runtime improvements). I want to lock sequencing and identify any documentation or enablement exceptions that should prevent the proposed timeline. Goal is to finalize an internal decision by EOD Mon 2026-10-19 so we can publish enablement invites and customer comms.

Proposed sequence (please review and call out blockers):
- Nov 09 — Canary starts (5% hosted traffic, 1 dedicated pool)
- Nov 16 — Expand canary to 25% + limited Dedicated customers (by invitation)
- Nov 23 — Threshold review; if metrics green, begin gradual ramp to 75%
- Dec 01 — Full rollout to standard routing (target, may shift based on canary)

Key asks for this thread:
1) Doc owners for: migration guide, release notes, SDK diff, troubleshooting runbook (assign by Oct 20)
2) Enablement schedule: 2x 60m sessions + on-demand quickstart; proposed Nov 06–08
3) Exceptions list: any customer or region that must be excluded from canary (e.g., EU private deployments, customers with quantization opt-out, or high-compliance customers)
4) Technical gating criteria: perf (p50/p95), cost delta, regression rate, and a known-good fallback path

I've attached a working timeline spreadsheet (v2_release_timeline.xlsx). Please reply with concise commitments or redlines. If you need more time for docs, say so and propose a new date.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks — couple of technical concerns that could change sequencing: 
1) Routing fallback: for Dedicated customers we should not flip routes until the Dedicated pool has been exercised for at least 48h under canary. Suggest we gate Dedicated expansion until Nov 18.
2) EU private deployments: our current audit window for the private control plane still has two open items; recommending we treat EU private as an explicit hold-out and run a separate EU-only canary.
3) SDK diffs: there is an API surface change in the new shortcut calls; I can produce the migration snippets but need until Nov 02 to finalize docs and code samples.

Thanks all for quick replies — summary and firmed decisions below. If anything here is inaccurate, flag immediately. Otherwise this is the source of truth for comms and enablement invites.

Decisions:
- Canary start: Nov 09 (hosted 5%). Dedicated expansion delayed to Nov 18 after 48h Dedicated exercise.
- EU private deployments: separate EU-only canary; EU canary window Nov 23–Dec 07; EU customers will be excluded from the global hosted canary.
- Docs freeze: customer-facing docs final by Nov 09; internal runbook freeze Nov 16. SDK samples deadline Nov 02 (Karthik) — Marcus asked for an extra week; Karthik and Marcus to reconcile today.
- Enablement sessions: Nov 07 (Solutions dry-run 11:00 PT) and Nov 08 (customer session 09:00 PT). Recording uploaded to the Drive link below.
- Exceptions: quantization opt-out customers (Finance flagged) will be excluded from canary. Sales to provide list by Oct 18.
- Runbook & Go/No-Go: Dev owns canary runbook; dry-run scheduled Nov 02.

Next steps and owners:
- Laura: migration guide owner — draft due Oct 29.
- Karthik & Marcus: SDK + samples alignment — reconcile by Oct 14.
- Marissa: finalize enablement deck and recording logistics by Oct 25.
- Dev: runbook owner and dry-run on Nov 02.
- Sales: provide quantization opt-out list (Oct 18) and any customers to remove from canary.

Resources:
- Timeline spreadsheet: v2_release_timeline.xlsx (see attachment)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_release_folder
- HubSpot deal tracker: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/HL-8723

Please reply with a one-line ack or a redline if anything prevents your commitment. Final sign-off targeted by Oct 20 so we can schedule invites and the customer FAQ.

Irene
